basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Applied AI Architect · Claude & LLM Solutions · Pre-Sales Technical Advisor · Evals & Safe Deployment
basics.summary: Applied AI architect who takes enterprises from discovery to LLMs in production, and who builds on Claude every day. 13+ years shipping software, now embedding with teams to design scalable architectures, develop evals, and integrate AI into a live enterprise stack. I translate between engineers and C-suite (MBA), and I run to safety and reliability, not just demos: my rule is that if the model can't explain its output, it doesn't ship, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints and guardrails built in. At LumApps my agent deployments 2x conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue; at Beekeeper I replaced $337K in cost with an LLM pipeline gated by evals.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Anthropic, Zurich. Applied AI Architect (Industries) on the Applied AI team: a pre-sales architect and trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and integrate/deploy it into their stack. Combine deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect LLM solutions to business challenges while maintaining safety and reliability. Work with Sales, Product, and Engineering to guide customers from technical discovery through deployment; help customers understand Claude, develop evals, and design scalable architectures. Responsibilities: partner with account executives to translate customer requirements into technical solutions; serve as primary technical advisor across the Claude adoption journey (discovery to evaluation to deployment), coordinating across teams; support customers building with the Claude API and Claude for Work; create and deliver technical content for audiences from engineering deep dives to executive value conversations; guide technical architecture decisions and integration into existing stacks; help customers develop evaluation frameworks; identify integration patterns and feed insights to Product/Engineering; travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops and deep dives; maintain knowledge of LLM developments. Good fit: 5+ years in technical customer-facing roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, TAM); NATIVE OR C1 GERMAN AND FRENCH with fluent English; enterprise customers and complex buying cycles; exceptional relationship-building and technical communication to C-suite, engineering, and IT; translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders; designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating enterprise systems; comfortable with Python; familiarity with LLM frameworks or ML/data science background; cross-organizational collaboration and trade-offs; a love of teaching and mentoring; passion for safe and beneficial AI.
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong technical fit: builds on Claude/Anthropic APIs in production, evals as release gates, scalable architecture + enterprise integration, discovery-to-deployment advisory, technical content across audiences (talks/tutorials), teaching/mentoring, and deep alignment with safe/interpretable AI (explainability rule, human-in-the-loop, guardrails). HARD GAP NOT fabricated: the role requires native/C1 GERMAN AND FRENCH; candidate speaks English (professional) and Tamil (native), not German or French. This is likely a blocker for this specific posting unless the language bar is flexible. Also formal pre-sales title tenure is via FDE/advisory work rather than a Solutions Architect/SE title.
